rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of compound with patra
second member of compound describing cakraṃ
adjective qualifying cakraṃ, possessing a pericarp

items.question: What specific form and attributes characterize the sixth cakra in this sequence?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified as the object of description.
This cakra is designated by the epithet king.
The cakra possesses eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a royal eight-petaled center endowed with a pericarp.
uncertainties: The exact contextual sense of rājānam as an epithet is not fully specified.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is the kingly one, having eight petals and a pericarp.
